blind.description: A stylized wooden merchant handcart topped with an arched fabric canopy featuring alternating cream and warm ochre stripes. The body consists of timber framing with red-painted floorboards and side panels, resting on two red-hubbed wooden wheels and two front support props. Three wooden pull shafts extend forward. Inside the cart bed sits various cargo, including tied fabric sacks, a small wooden cask, and ceramic jugs, with a small lantern and accessories mounted on exterior side ledges.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular striped canopy dominates the view, with three wooden handle shafts extending downward and wheels and cargo shelves barely peeking out from the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 3.8 ft tall), and about 5 ft in total length from handle tips to rear.
